inlineContent.text: Apple Video Podcasts are now available in the Apple TV app. Watch full episodes of your favorite video podcasts, and pick up where you left off from Apple Podcasts.
CIRAWFilter now relies on resources that aren’t included with the operating system. To download them, use the
and
methods of CIRAWFilter.

The system now keeps a set of unused evaluation keys uploaded to your Live Caller ID Lookup service, and when it runs out of pre-uploaded keys, it automatically falls back to sending a fresh evaluation key inline with the query. When a query includes an evaluation key, your service must use it directly instead of looking one up by the user identifier.

Live Caller ID Lookup now requires the shard count in a service’s PIR configuration to be a power of two, for example, 256, 512, 1024, or 2048. The system rejects a configuration whose shard count isn’t a power of two. Configurations that already use a power-of-two shard count work with earlier releases and need no changes.

The system now keeps a set of unused evaluation keys uploaded to your NEURLFilter PIR service, and when it runs out of pre-uploaded keys, it automatically falls back to sending a fresh evaluation key inline with the query. When a query includes an evaluation key, your service must use it directly instead of looking one up by the user identifier.
NEURLFilter no longer supports user tiers. The system no longer calls your service’s
endpoint and instead uses the first valid public key in your Privacy Pass token issuer directory.

NEURLFilter now limits a service’s PIR configuration to at most 65,536 shards and requires the shard count to be a power of two, for example, 256, 512, 1024, or 2048. The system rejects a configuration that exceeds the limit or whose shard count isn’t a power of two. Configurations that already meet both constraints work with earlier releases and need no changes.
